_note: Quests (docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 5). Every number is a [PLACEHOLDER]. Read by scripts/quests/quest_engine.gd, which only watches what GameState already keeps. A quest: kind (story, lab, personal, daily), giver (a cast id), title, scope (farm, or player: each player's own, kept on the farm and in a guest's own file), gates (lab_level, band, skill {id, level}, total_level, quest_points, quest_done: all must hold), offer (when: always, day_at_least with day, or any step check with its fields), offer_line (what the giver says with the offer: a path in dialogue_dispatches.json or the line itself), steps (in order unless any_order is true) and rewards (credits, lab_xp, xp_<skill id>, quest_points, xp_certificate, phone: a path in dialogue_dispatches.json or the line itself). xp_certificate is the XP one certificate is worth: each player who took part is given one and spends it on one skill of their own (SKILLS, K). It is sized to the quest, not the player, so the 10 % curve makes it lift a low level a lot and a high level a little. A step: id, text, check and its fields, at_least (1 if left out). The count and counter checks count from the day the quest was accepted unless ever is true. In a quest done in order, a later count or counter step counts from when the step before it was done (unless ever is true), so what is done early is not counted for a later step. Checks: stat_at_least (stat), flag (flag), band_at_least (band), owns_standard (standard_id), lab_size, count (log, where), state_is (state, is: one value or a list), level (skill: a skill id, lab or total), counter (counter: a source id of data/skills.json, or crops_sold_in_spec with where { crop_id }: what Lin has bought in spec). A step may carry minigame (a mini-game's id: set_the_zero or hold_the_reading, the two bench games; the instrument decides which of the two is played, MinigameScore.game_for, so the step must name a game its instrument plays by the data, MinigameScore.games_in_data, or the quest does not load): it must be a count of cal_log rows whose where names one instrument_id, and while it is the quest's open step the bench opens that game for that instrument, on a farm that has calibrated its kind before too. The step is done by its check alone, so a skip or a poor try does it as a plain calibration does. A score of 60 or more is kept with the step; when the quest is paid, Fine (80) adds 10 % of the quest's credits and Reference (95) adds 20 % [ASSUMPTION], and at Reference the giver also says the step's minigame_line (a path in dialogue_dispatches.json or the line itself). Lab and daily quests pay no quest points. closed_when (when: a step check with its fields): a quest that was never offered is marked done with nothing paid once this holds, for an offer that can no longer come. A quest id and a step id are kept in saves and must never be renamed; a quest must have steps, each a dictionary with its own id. A quest may have endings (a list of { id, when and that check's fields, phone }): when it is paid, the giver says the phone line of the first ending whose check holds, in place of the reward's phone; an ending's when is always, day_at_least or a step check, and is looked at before the quest is paid; every ending pays the same, and which one it was is not kept. The count logs are cal_log, job_log, audit_log, certificates and oirm_trips. Quests are offered each morning and when a farm is opened, not after a command. The lab-level gates of the design's unlock table (section 3.4) are in data/skills.json lab_gates, not here; a quest's own gates lab_level is its own offer level, and the daily asks' must say the level of the daily_asks row. any_gate (a list of gates dictionaries): at least one of them must hold, beside gates, which must all hold; this is how a quest says 'credibility 20, or lab level 6'. The gate credibility is the farm's credibility points. A farm's quest may have a job: a job as data/economy.json's templates are (id, customer, item, discipline, min_tier, pay, due_in_days, bench_minutes; no min_band and no area), handed out by the quest into active_jobs and never on the board, with the quest's id on it and on its job_log row (quest). It is handed out when the quest is offered, whatever the lab can do yet, and again on any morning or farm opening that finds the quest open with no such job accepted and no such row in job_log, so a job that ran out or was dropped comes back as often as it takes (the giver then says job_again_line); a quest's job that runs out costs no credibility. A job with flat_cut_pct is cut once by that much when it is late, untraceable or both, in place of the board's two cuts; the credibility points and the job XP are a board job's. The check quest_job (quest: the quest's id) is 1 once that job is accepted or done. S3's envelope, its 200 CR, its half, the three days and the pressure gauge are [PLACEHOLDER]. A quest of kind daily is a daily ask (section 6, D2): scope player, no quest points, and one a day for each player. Each morning (and when a farm is opened, or a guest comes in) a player who holds none of today's is given one of the asks whose gates and offer hold for them, picked by the farm's seed, the day and the player, so host, guest and reload agree. Its entry sits with the player's own quests and `accepted` is its day; an ask of another day is taken out on the next look, done or not, with nothing paid and nothing lost, and can be asked again. The offer is posted as the giver's line and 'Today's ask:' with the step. Counting starts when the ask is given. A counter step with whose: farm counts every player's doing, in a player's own quest too: the asks about what the farm shares (Orin's row on the plot, Bram's ore from the fissures) use it, with an offer that needs enough left (plot_untilled, fissures_open), so another player using the plot or the fissures moves the ask on and never puts it out of reach. A daily ask does not travel in a guest's file, and its XP certificate is given every time it is done and stays on the farm that gave it. Two checks for offers: found_blocks (how many reference blocks the farm has dug up) and plot_untilled (how many plot cells are still to till), so an ask that could not be done is not picked. The counter check_with_block:<instrument id> is a player's checks of that instrument against a block (GameState.check_with_block; it gives no XP). daily_lin_reeds counts what Lin bought from the whole farm, as crops_sold_in_spec always does. The asks' sizes, the 30 to 60 CR and the 25 XP certificate are [PLACEHOLDER]. A step may instead carry minigame wring_the_blocks (section 7, mini-game 2): it must be a counter of build_block_stack, a player's built stacks of gauge blocks (GameState.build_block_stack, key J; it gives no XP). The build is the game: the length is the sum of pieces the farm holds, a skip or a poor try builds the stack as a good try does, and a score of 60 or more is kept with the step as Set the Zero's is. The bonus for Fine and Reference is also paid on the quest's skill XP (xp_<skill id>), by the same share [ASSUMPTION], so a quest with no credits has one. The gate found_blocks is how many reference blocks the farm has dug up. The counter blocks_found is the same number as a counter, so a step of it is 'find that many more'. A counter ending in * adds up every count that starts with what is before it: check_with_block:* is a check of any instrument. A reward may be keepsake: the id of one in keepsakes below (display_name, text). A reward may be one_use: the id of one in one_use_rewards below (display_name, holder player or farm, pct for a discount, text, held_line, used_line). It is held on the farm (one_use_held, saved) until the action it is for uses it on its own and says so on the phone: bram_discount_10 (holder player: 10 % off the next standard Bram sells, shown in his catalog while it is held; the gates still apply) and free_lab_refit (holder farm: the next lab space cleared costs nothing [ASSUMPTION], the day it takes stays). A player's reward is for a player's own quest, the farm's for a farm quest; no daily ask pays one. The 10 % and the lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. A keepsake is for show and gives no power. It is only for a player's own quest that is not a daily ask and has no closed_when, and nothing is saved for it: a player holds the keepsakes of their own quests that are done. missing_blocks is P3 (section 5.4): its 3 blocks, its 150 Earthworks XP and Orin's lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. A step may instead carry minigame thread_the_spool (section 7, mini-game 5): it must be a counter of slot_spool, the spools seated in the relay. While it is a player's open step, seating a spool on the farm screen opens the game first. The seat is the same whatever the score: the same spool, the same lag. A score of 60 or more is kept with the step as the others are, and it also multiplies that seat's own Husbandry XP and lab XP (MinigameScore.GRADES xp: 1.15, 1.3, 1.5). a_clean_line is the quest that carries it: offered on a morning with a spool in stock, and its 60 CR, 100 lab XP and Odalys' lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. A step may instead carry minigame torque_to_spec (section 7, mini-game 4): it must be a counter of service_wheels, Bram's wheel services. While it is a player's open step, the wheel service in Bram's bay opens the game first: five nuts in star order. The service is the same whatever the score: the same meters, the same distance to the next one. A score of 60 or more is kept with the step as the others are, and it also multiplies that service's own Robotics XP and lab XP (MinigameScore.GRADES xp: 1.15, 1.3, 1.5). One more check for offers: wheels_due (1 while the rover's wheel nuts are due). to_the_click is the quest that carries the game: offered on a morning with the nuts due, and its 60 CR, 100 lab XP and Bram's lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. A quest may carry zone (a zone id of data/zones.json): the zone's notice board lists it. A step may check beacons_placed (how many of the Lava Tubes' beacon spots have a beacon; the farm's, whoever set them down; not a counting check, so one set down before the quest was offered counts, and at_least may not be more than the spots there are). beacon_run is zones build step 5: its gate (lab level 5), its three beacons, its 1 quest point, its 50 XP certificate and Orin's lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. A quest may carry board (farm): the farm notice board lists it, as a zone's board lists its zone's quests. A step may carry prompt (an input action): the board adds what to press for it, built when it is shown and never kept here. first_water, read_the_probe and first_calibration are the three starter jobs (docs/design/biomes.md section 4): Lin gives all three, offered on day 1 or 2 only (offer day_at_most, with day and unless_taken: the quest whose being under way closes the offer), so an old save is never given them, and they come before thirsty_probe in this list so a day-2 morning offers them before that quest closes the offer; a count where key that starts with not_ matches rows whose value differs (first_calibration counts a traceable row not performed by the Manager, so zeroing the steering and the audit grace do not count); first_water is one step, a plant_crop, so a plot with no cell left to till can still finish it; the counter read_probe is a player's clicks on the soil probe (GameState.read_probe; it gives no XP). Their 25, 25 and 50 CR and lab XP are [PLACEHOLDER]. A quest may carry camp (a zone id that has a camp, Camp): taking the quest opens that zone's camp for the farm (GameState.open_camp), where a night is going to bed with no rescue fee. The counter camp_night is a player's nights at a camp (GameState.go_to_bed there; it gives no XP). strays is Phobos part 2 (zones build step 17): offered once a player has reached Phobos (the counter reached_<moon>, a player's arrivals on a moon, gives no XP), done by the player's first catch of a stray (the counter catch_stray, GameState.catch_stray, no XP); its 100 Husbandry XP and Odalys' lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. two_sunsets is zones build step 12: its gate (lab level 5), its one night, its 30 XP certificate and Orin's lines are [PLACEHOLDER]. old_props and colonists_set are the Colony Mine's two quests (zones build step 14 follow-up): old_props (lab, Bram, farm, lab level 12 and the_gate_key done) counts shore_room across the farm (2 rockfalls; the lift step waits until the Mine has a lift) and pays 300 lab XP and a lab_sitter one-use; colonists_set (personal, Bram, player, Earthworks 5 or the_gate_key done) counts open_colonist_case per player (3 cases) and pays 150 Earthworks XP and the colonists_case keepsake [PLACEHOLDER].

steps.text: Pass an audit with no findings.
Finish the OIRM contract's run of on-time calibrations.
Till a cell of the plot, then plant a seed in it. The cistern waters planted ground at dawn.
Click the soil probe in the plot and read what it says.
Calibrate any instrument at the bench in the dome.
Own the gravimetric kit.
Calibrate the soil probe against the gravimetric kit.
Sell Lin a crate of in-spec dust turnip.
Have your first audit on file.
Open an OIRM account.
Send a standard to OIRM.
Get its certificate back.

job.item: a pressure gauge that will not read right

steps.text: Take the envelope job from under the airlock.
Calibrate the gauge at the bench and hand it back.
Sell Lin three in-spec Biscuit Reeds.
Mine two fissures for crystal ore.
Check the rover's steering encoder against a reference block.
Till six cells of the plot.
Dig up three more reference blocks.
Check an instrument against a reference block.
Wring a stack of gauge blocks to the length Orin names (J).
Start the medium lab's grow (600 CR and 4 crystal ore).
Move into the medium lab (it is ready two days after the grow starts).
Fit out one space an area never had before (a lab with every space fitted must clear one, and fit another area).
Mine five fissures yourself.
Calibrate any instrument at the bench in the dome: traceable, on time and by your own hand, not a robot's.
Calibrate five instruments on time, yourself.
Seat a silk spool in the uplink relay.
Re-torque the rover's wheel nuts in Bram's bay.
Show Bram you can work rock: mine two fissures in the Lava Tubes.
Shore two rockfalls in the Colony Mine.
Open three colonist's cases in the Colony Mine yourself.
Place three of Orin's beacons in the deeper Lava Tubes.
Survey the shaft over a night: park the rover at the Lava Tubes camp and go to bed there.
Catch an escaped station tarantula in the Phobos service tunnel.
Book an expedition to Deimos at the pad terminal.
Spend 2 nights at the Deimos camp: turn in there each night.
Come home when the expedition ends. Leaving early does not count.

keepsakes.text: Orin's old block case. The felt still holds the shape of every block that was ever in it.
[PLACEHOLDER] A brass pocket watch. It runs a little slow, and it has never once been late.
[PLACEHOLDER] A latched cedar block case from the first mine crew, stamped with a shop number nobody files under anymore.

one_use_rewards.used_line: LAB: The refit was free. That one is spent.

one_use_rewards.text: Dana Pike minds the lab for one day, free.
